caseName: Harbor Creek Holdings LLC v. Harbor Creek Partners LLC

recap_documents.description: COMPLAINT against Harbor Creek Partners LLC. Breach of contract. Jury demand.
recap_documents.snippet: Plaintiff seeks compensatory damages for unpaid invoices.

recap_documents.description: STIPULATION of Dismissal and Consent Judgment. Settlement confidential.
recap_documents.snippet: The parties stipulate to entry of consent judgment in the amount of $500,000, characterized as damages for personal physical injury and physical sickness, to be paid as a structured settlement. Papers to be sealed.

caseName: Alvarez v. National Parcel Service Inc

recap_documents.snippet: Plaintiff alleges unpaid overtime and retaliation.

recap_documents.description: Joint stipulation of settlement and dismissal with prejudice.
recap_documents.snippet: The parties have reached a settlement of employment claims. Case dismissed with prejudice.

recap_documents.description: REQUEST for Entry of Default Judgment.
recap_documents.snippet: Plaintiff requests default judgment in the amount of $1,000,000 together with assignment of settlement proceeds to a structured settlement annuity.
